modelOverview: The RM 030 line is built around Richard Mille's declutchable rotor, a mechanism that disengages the oscillating weight from the barrel once the mainspring is fully wound, preventing over-tension and wear. The 2023 RM 30-01 reworked the concept with the new Calibre RMAR2, a redesigned tonneau case and a clearer indicator layout, taking over from the original RM 030 launched in 2011.

RM 30-01.movement: Automatic · Richard Mille Calibre RMAR2 · skeletonised, declutchable variable-geometry rotor with 18k white gold wings · 28,800vph · ~55h power reserve
RM 30-01.materials: Available in grade 5 titanium, or 18k 5N red gold bezel and caseback with a grade 5 titanium caseband
RM 30-01.dial: Skeletonised dial exposing the grade 5 titanium baseplate and bridges, with oversize date, clutch-engagement and power-reserve indicators and a function selector
RM 30-01.description: The RM 30-01 Automatic with Declutchable Rotor is the second generation of Richard Mille's self-winding movement that automatically disconnects its rotor from the barrel at full wind, a state the wearer can read off the dial alongside the power reserve and oversize date. The Calibre RMAR2 sits in a tonneau case weighing 96 grams complete with strap, in titanium or red gold and titanium. Every piece we offer is sourced and independently authenticated before sale.

variants.Automatic with Declutchable Rotor: The RM 30-01 as introduced in 2023 — tonneau case with skeletonised Calibre RMAR2, declutchable variable-geometry rotor, oversize date, clutch and power-reserve indicators and function selector, in titanium or red gold and titanium.
